en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said regarding the thief: ‘When he is seized and he has taken the goods, and he is in the house and not having come out. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no cutting upon him until he comes out with it (the goods) from the house’.
